headline: South Maui plan review: parcels, drainage, and appendix changes

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.voteItem: Amend page 152 to add an appendices header
meeting.summary: The committee reviewed South Maui Community Plan map changes, voted 7–0 on four amendments, and deferred the bill to the next meeting.
meeting.recap: The only agenda item was Bill 108, the 2026 South Maui Community Plan.[[0:05:36]] Members reviewed land use map changes, parcel by parcel, in Attachment 3B.[[0:06:39]] A council member said four parcels the county hopes to buy are for sale for $6,150,000 in total.[[0:21:12]] Members agreed to ask about a proposed fire station and affordable housing overlapping drainage basins in a developer's plan.[[0:47:07]] The committee voted 7–0 to replace A1 and A2 zoning with H3 and H4 in a resort hotel table row.[[3:16:47]] A department director said a heiau (temple site) named in public testimony should be added to the plan's list of significant sites.[[3:24:09]] Planning staff said the plan's advisory committee voted unanimously on July 14, 2023, to make the farmland strip open space because of cultural sites.[[4:37:08]] The item was deferred, and the amended main motion carries over to the next meeting.[[5:32:35]]
decided: Members agreed to keep the resort hotel designation for a hotel parking garage parcel; no vote was taken.
The committee approved adding an "Appendices" heading on page 152 saying the appendices hold supplemental information, 7–0.
The committee approved listing two draft Kīhei drainage master plans, from 2020 and 2016, on page 151, 7–0.
meeting.next: The committee will send a transmittal about the fire station and affordable housing overlapping drainage basins. The committee will ask Public Works how a developer's drainage master plan fits the regional drainage master plan. A county lawyer will work with Planning on how to describe the strip that would become open space. The chair will work with staff on a priority ranking proposal for Appendix H using the advisory committee's poll scores.
